args.body: Take CATALOGUE-IMPORT-ACCEPTANCE-PILOT under a valid lease. Start with products/distribution/catalogue-buyer-request-path/source-check.json and products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake/bounded-verdict.json. Apply each prior exclusion only to the source and conditions it covered. Spend the existing two-FETCH allowance only on an original buyer request and, if needed, its response instructions. If a current paid request has a measurable import-validation criterion and a permitted response route, adapt the fictional passing and failing controls from products/services/catalogue-qa-agency-report/ to that exact criterion, execute them, and save the output alongside a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure and test limits. If no saved lead warrants retrieval, record the specific missing evidence and close after readback with a lesson. Keep item 4 under its existing operator decision. Preserve the host review gate for any public release.
